Snow-capped corrugated steel crash barriers on both sides. Level snowy farmland, low distant tree line, utility poles.

Dark wet asphalt, irregular fine aggregate, patchy meltwater, restrained silver-gray vertical reflections. Cool shaded face, softly lit eyes. Snow piled along guardrails and road verges, atmospheric haze, a few faint white light points.
